license_required.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board to practice dentistry before the individual may practice dentistry on a human being in this State.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dental Examiners.

name.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dental Examiners.

type.quote: "Board" means the State Board of Dental Examiners.

age_minimum.quote: To qualify for a license to practice dentistry, the applicant shall be at least 18 years old.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery, Doctor of Dental Medicine, or the equivalent
degree_required.quote: to qualify for a license to practice dentistry, the applicant shall hold a degree of Doctor of Dental Surgery, Doctor of Dental Medicine, or the equivalent, from a college or university

accrediting_body.value: Board-recognized college or university authorized by any state or province of Canada
accrediting_body.quote: from a college or university that is: (1) Authorized by any state or any province of Canada to grant the degree; and (2) Recognized by the Board as requiring adequate preprofessional collegiate training and as maintaining an acceptable course of dental instruction.

exams.name: ADLEX (American Dental Licensing Examination)
exams.notes: Required for licensure by endorsement from another state; includes written and clinical components
exams.quote: Has passed the ADLEX; and Has passed the Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination given by the Board or its designee

exams.name: Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination
exams.quote: Has passed the Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination given by the Board or its designee

exams.name: Board examination
exams.notes: Required for general license; applicant who fails 4 times may not be licensed
exams.quote: to qualify for a general license to practice dentistry or a general license to practice dental hygiene, the applicant shall pass an examination given by the Board under this subtitle.

interval_years.quote: A license may not be renewed for a term longer than 2 years.

required.quote: Adopt regulations establishing continuing education requirements for licensed dentists

available.quote: A dentist licensed in any other state shall be issued a license in this State if the applicant

requirements.value: Must have passed the ADLEX and Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination, OR have been actively practicing dentistry for at least 850 hours/year for the preceding 5 years, passed an examination with a clinical component in another state, passed a comprehensive written examination by ADEX, and passed the Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination.
requirements.quote: A dentist licensed in any other state shall be issued a license in this State if the applicant: (i) 1. Has passed the ADLEX; and 2. Has passed the Maryland Dental Jurisprudence Examination given by the Board or its designee; or (ii) 1. For the 5 preceding years, has been actively engaged in practicing dentistry for at least 850 hours on average per year

regulatory_model.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene on a human being in this State unless licensed by the Board.

credential_type.quote: an individual shall be licensed by the Board to practice dentistry before the individual may practice dentistry on a human being in this State.

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene on a human being in this State unless licensed by the Board.

title_protection.quote: unless authorized to practice dentistry under this title, a person may not represent to the public by title, by description of services, methods, or procedures, or otherwise, that the person is authorized to practice dentistry in this State.

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this title, a person may not practice, attempt to practice, or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene on a human being in this State unless licensed by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively obtaining or attempting to obtain a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively obtains or attempts to obtain a license for the applicant or licensee or for another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently or deceptively using a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently or deceptively uses a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a fee by fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtains a fee by fraud or attempts to obtain a fee by fraud

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is convicted of or pleads guilty or nolo contendere to a felony or to a crime involving moral turpitude, whether or not any appeal or other proceeding is pending to have the conviction or plea set aside

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing professional services while under the influence of alcohol or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides professional services while: (i) Under the influence of alcohol; or (ii) Using any narcotic or controlled dangerous substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry in a professionally incompetent or grossly incompetent manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practices dentistry in a professionally incompetent manner or in a grossly incompetent manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice dentistry revoked or suspended in any other state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license to practice dentistry revoked or suspended in any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting an unauthorized individual to practice dentistry under the licensee's supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permits an unauthorized individual to practice dentistry under the supervision of the applicant or licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Behaving dishonorably or unprofessionally, or violating a professional code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Behaves dishonorably or unprofessionally, or violates a professional code of ethics pertaining to the dentistry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being mentally or physically incompetent to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is mentally or physically incompetent to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrating a course of conduct inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrates a course of conduct of providing dental care that is inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards of care in the practice of dentistry, regardless of whether actual injury to the patient occurs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing a dental service in a manner significantly inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Provides a dental service in a manner that is significantly inconsistent with generally accepted professional standards of care in the practice of dentistry, regardless of whether actual injury to the patient occurs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any rule or regulation adopted by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates any rule or regulation adopted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority of another state or country for an act that would be grounds for discipline in Maryland
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is disciplined by a licensing or disciplinary authority of any other state or country or convicted or disciplined by a court of any state or country for an act that would be grounds for disciplinary action under the Board's disciplinary statutes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing a false report or record in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully makes or files a false report or record in the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting a claim containing misleading, deceptive, false, or fraudulent representations asserting a fee greater than usually accepted
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly submits to a third party any claim form, bill, or statement which contains any misleading, deceptive, false, incomplete, or fraudulent representation asserting a fee which is greater than the fee that the dentist usually accepts as payment in full

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abrogating or forgiving copayment provisions of insurance contracts without disclosure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abrogates or forgives the copayment provisions of any insurance policy, insurance contract, health prepayment contract, health care plan, or nonprofit health service plan contract by accepting the payment received from a third party as full payment, unless the dentist discloses to the third party that the patient's payment portion will not be collected

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using or promoting misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising matter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Uses or promotes or causes the use of any misleading, deceiving, or untruthful advertising matter, promotional literature, or testimonial

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing or discriminating against an individual in providing professional services because the individual is HIV positive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refuses, withholds from, denies, or discriminates against an individual with regard to the provision of professional services for which the licensee is licensed and qualified to render because the individual is HIV positive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with CDC guidelines on universal precautions except in emergency life-threatening situations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except in an emergency life–threatening situation where it is not feasible or practicable, fails to comply with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's guidelines on universal precautions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any Board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to comply with any Board order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and without legal justification failing to cooperate with a lawful Board investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and without legal justification, fails to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program in Title 21, Subtitle 2A of the Health – General Article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting or tendering rebates or splitting fees in violation of § 4-103(c)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepts or tenders rebates or splits fees in violation of § 4–103(c) of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing a dental assistant to assist in the practice of dentistry in an unauthorized manner or without proper supervision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allows a dental assistant to assist in the practice of dentistry: (i) In an unauthorized manner in violation of this title or regulations adopted by the Board; (ii) Without specifically instructing the certified dental assistant to perform an intraoral procedure that the certified dental assistant is authorized to perform; or (iii) Failing to provide direct supervision of a dental assistant.

definition_quote.value: "Practice dentistry" means to: (i) Perform or attempt to perform any intraoral dental service or intraoral dental operation; (ii) Diagnose, treat, or attempt to diagnose or treat any disease, injury, malocclusion, or malposition of a tooth, gum, or jaw, or structures associated with a tooth, gum, or jaw if the service, operation, or procedure is included in the curricula of an accredited dental school or in an approved dental residency program of an accredited hospital or teaching institution; (iii) Perform or offer to perform dental laboratory work; (iv) Place or adjust a dental appliance in a human mouth; or (v) Administer anesthesia for the purposes of dentistry and not as a medical specialty.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice dentistry" means to: (i) Perform or attempt to perform any intraoral dental service or intraoral dental operation

value: Intraoral dental services and operations
Diagnosis and treatment of disease, injury, malocclusion, or malposition of tooth, gum, or jaw
Dental laboratory work
Placement and adjustment of dental appliances
Administration of anesthesia for dentistry
Patient evaluation, diagnosis, and determination of treatment plans
Determination of treatment options including restorative and treatment materials
Determination and establishment of dental patient protocols and standards of care
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice dentistry" means to: (i) Perform or attempt to perform any intraoral dental service or intraoral dental operation; (ii) Diagnose, treat, or attempt to diagnose or treat any disease, injury, malocclusion, or malposition of a tooth, gum, or jaw

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may dispense prescription drugs subject to Board regulations adopted after consulting with the State Board of Pharmacy; opioid prescribing is subject to statutory limits under § 1-223.
drug_authority.quote: After consulting with the State Board of Pharmacy, adopt regulations regarding the dispensing of prescription drugs by a licensed dentist

value: General anesthesia permit
Sedation permit
sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: the issuance of a permit to a facility not otherwise regulated where a dentist administers or has general anesthesia or sedation administered; (v) Subject to subsection (b) of this section, the issuance of a permit to a dentist who administers or has general anesthesia or sedation administered

specialist_license_available.quote: A licensed dentist may not represent to the public that the licensee is a specialist in any field of specialized dental practice unless identified as a specialist in that field by the Board.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: A licensed dentist may not: (i) Use the designation "Dental Surgeon" on a sign that bears the name of the licensee; or (ii) Include a specialty designation in a card, letterhead, sign, telephone directory listing, or other printed matter that bears the name of the licensee, unless: 1. The licensee is identified by the Board as a specialist in the designated field under § 4-504 of this subtitle; and 2. The language used to refer to the specialty is approved by the Board.

value: Supervision (dentist on premises and available for personal consultation)
General supervision (dentist may or may not be present when dental hygienist performs procedures)
Unsupervised at community-based health fairs (no dentist supervision required for specified services)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist by a dentist, where the dentist may or may not be present when the dental hygienist performs the dental hygiene procedures but is available on the premises.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: there is a written agreement between the supervising dentist and the dental hygienist practicing under general supervision that clearly sets forth the terms and conditions under which the dental hygienist may practice, including a statement that the dental hygienist may provide dental hygiene services without the supervising dentist on the premises.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A supervising dentist may not employ more than two dental hygienists to work under the dentist's general supervision at any given time.

value: Patients in dental facilities owned and operated by federal, State, or local government
Patients in public health departments or public schools
Patients in facilities where a licensed Department program is operating
Patients in facilities owned and operated by the Department of Juvenile Services
Patients in facilities providing medical care to the poor, elderly, or handicapped owned by State or local government
Patients in federally qualified health centers or look-alikes
Patients in State licensed Head Start or Early Head Start programs
Patients in nursing homes, assisted living programs, clinical offices, group homes, or adult day care centers
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: a general license to practice dental hygiene issued under this title authorizes the licensee to practice dental hygiene under general supervision in: 1. A dental facility owned and operated by the federal, the State, or a local government; 2. A public health department or public school of the State or a county

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: Require applicants for an initial license and applicants for a license renewal to report whether the applicant provides or intends to provide mobile dental services or portable dental services; and Publish on the Board's website a searchable list of licensed dentists and licensed dental hygienists who provide mobile dental services or portable dental services in the State

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: A dentist who holds a temporary volunteer dentist's license or the temporary dental clinic in which the dentist is providing services shall provide a form to a patient at the conclusion of treatment that contains: (i) A summary of the services that were provided to the patient by the dentist and, if applicable, the dental hygienist; and (ii) Instructions for any recommended follow–up dental care.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only an individual or individuals licensed by the Board to practice dentistry or a dental professional corporation may own a dental practice.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Fails to comply with § 1–223 of this article

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Fails to comply with the requirements of the Prescription Drug Monitoring Program in Title 21, Subtitle 2A of the Health – General Article

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: The work authorization required by § 4-402 of this subtitle for dental laboratory work shall: (1) Be on the form that the Board requires; (2) Be signed by a licensed dentist who requests the work; and (3) Contain the information required by this section.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Before a dental hygienist may administer local anesthesia under subsection (a) of this section, the dental hygienist shall successfully complete the following: (1) Any educational requirements established by the Board; and (2) A written and clinical examination as required by the Board.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: Before a dental hygienist may administer nitrous oxide under subsection (a) of this section, the dental hygienist shall successfully complete the following: (1) Any educational requirements established by the Board; and (2) A written and clinical examination as required by the Board.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: If the dentist provides verification of current cardiopulmonary resuscitation certification.
